input: Buy a film camera and learn to shoot on 35mm

gold.taskTitle: Buy a Film Camera and Learn 35mm Photography
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to purchase a 35mm film camera and develop the skills to shoot film photography confidently.

questions.title: Have you ever shot on film before?
questions.description: Understanding the user's prior experience with film photography to gauge starting point.

questions.title: What is your total budget for camera and gear?
questions.description: Knowing the budget helps narrow down which camera bodies, lenses, and accessories are realistic options.

questions.title: Do you prefer automatic or fully manual camera controls?
questions.description: This determines whether to recommend point-and-shoot cameras versus SLR or rangefinder bodies.

questions.title: What kinds of subjects do you most want to photograph?
questions.description: Portraits, street, landscape, etc. will influence which camera and lens combination to prioritize.

questions.title: Will you develop film yourself or use a lab?
questions.description: Home developing requires additional equipment and chemicals; using a lab is simpler but has ongoing costs.

questions.title: Are you buying new, used, or open to either?
questions.description: Determines which marketplaces and camera sources to include in the buying plan.

questions.title: Do you have a timeline for when to shoot your first roll?
questions.description: A target date helps structure a realistic learning and purchasing schedule.
